title: Indiana Area School District
description: A school district in Indiana, Pennsylvania (approximately 2,800 students) is required to protect student education records, including medical records and personal information, in accordance with the Pennsylvania Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA). However, due to negligent security and uncooperative behavior, these records were compromised. Consequently, we are providing you with personal information, academic and behavioral records, and financial information, which violates privacy laws, requires notification of affected individuals, and exposes you to potential liability for negligence.
